channel.title: MPA-MLR · Machine Learning
channel.description: Talk podcasts about the lectures and labs of the course Machine Learning (MPA-MLR), in English and Czech, read by a local text-to-speech engine. Slides and materials are on the course web.
channel.itunes:author: Tomáš Vičar

item.title: Lecture 3 · Feature extraction, selection and dimensionality reduction — talk (EN)
item.description: A conversation of two hosts, in English, read by a local text-to-speech engine. Curse of dimensionality. Filter methods (correlation, entropy, mutual information, mRMR), wrappers (forward selection, backward elimination), embedded methods. PCA, LDA, t-SNE and UMAP, feature expansion.

item.title: Lecture 2 · Performance evaluation, metrics, preprocessing — talk (EN)
item.description: A conversation of two hosts, in English, read by a local text-to-speech engine. The supervised pipeline; train / validation / test as two nested optimization problems. Confusion-matrix metrics, ROC, the operating point, calibration, R². Class imbalance, cross-validation, scaling, imputation, outliers, encodings, and where information leaks.

item.title: Exercise 2 · k-NN as an object, metrics, splitting, standardization — talk (EN)
item.description: A conversation of two hosts, in English, read by a local text-to-speech engine. Includes the solutions of the lab. From NN to k-NN, the scikit-learn estimator interface, metrics from a confusion matrix by hand and in NumPy, hold-out split, standardization, and four broken pipelines to diagnose — the last one also to repair.

item.title: Lecture 1 · Introduction, optimization, how we code now — talk (EN)
item.description: A conversation of two hosts, in English, read by a local text-to-speech engine. What machine learning is; supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning. Distances, 1-NN, k-NN, k-means, UPGMA. Optimization: convexity, closed-form vs. iterative solutions. Why we compute by hand and validate what an agent writes.
